stats.source: Archived stock 314 records report direct Viral Accuracy stat 342 +108 at level 50 and +146 at level 69. The GOB uses a native function that does not reproduce those observed values on its own.
stats.runtime: AbilityScaledBuffs uses the disclosed affine rule through those two observed points. AbilityStats.ViralAccuracy consumes the direct bonus once. The native level-22 check measures the expected +52 record.
stats.test: AbilityScaledBuffTests covers live accuracy during active 314 and baseline restoration; HackerUpgradeAttacksMode verifies the exact two-second cast and 20-second lifetime. Stock PR852 records stat 342 +52 and matching removal. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/852#issuecomment-7087498888

behavior-tests.source: GOB 314 targets self, costs 35 IS, casts for 2 s and has 90 s own reuse, with a temporary direct Viral Accuracy bonus.
behavior-tests.runtime: The normal support handler ignores friendly selection for 314, applies the timed buff only to the caster, and removes it at expiry.
behavior-tests.test: Native PR852 sent a zero-target request while QAFriend was selected, paid 35 IS, received 90 s reuse and stat 342 +52 for 20 s only on CSR. The 80 bc records prove the active values; the tester did not open Status. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/852#issuecomment-7087498888
